question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word**.
solution:
The erroneous spelling is '**Spoorious**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The erroneous spelling for the incorrectly spelled word: **spoorious.**
 
• Let's look at the correct spelling and meaning of the word:
 
• **Spurious**: not being what it purports to be; false or fake.
 
 
• Example: *The court dismissed the **spurious __**arguments of the defense lawyer*.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Spacious- having ample space.
 
• Cautious- careful to avoid potential problems or dangers.
 
• Studious- spending a lot of time studying or reading.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• स्पूरियस - झूठा, जाली

 
 
• Example: *The shopkeeper had a reputation for selling **spurious **__milk.*
